headline: Auto-ship senior dog food trusted by parents
body: Save time with automatic deliveries of vet-formulated senior dog food. Made grain-free for aging joints. Set your schedule once and let us handle the rest.
rationale: This ad directly addresses The Busy Parent's need for convenience by emphasizing the subscription-based auto-ship model and time-saving nature. It uses verbatim messaging preferences like time-saving and trusted by parents while strictly avoiding luxury positioning and complicated onboarding.
